quest.rewards_formatted: Crystal Chunk x5, Noctilucous Jade x5, Cor Lapis x5

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mr. Miner, we're back and ready to report!

dialogues.speaker: Yuehui
dialogues.text: Ah! Am I glad to see you again! I was getting nervous... At first, I figured I'm paying a fair price, and these are professionals. But then I thought... Goodness, I'd hate to send someone off on a strange commission and then for something bad to happen to them...

dialogues.speaker: Yuehui
dialogues.text: I'd never be able to forgive myself if you came to any harm!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry, mister, it was nothing we couldn't handle! Anyway, we're back, aren't we? And the good news is, we got to the bottom of what's been going on!

dialogues.speaker: Yuehui
dialogues.text: Excellent, excellent! So then, what's the situation down there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Uh, basically, the hilichurls down there don't wanna fight anymore. Leave them in peace, and they won't cause you any trouble.

response.speaker: Yuehui
response.text: Well, we certainly wouldn't be going out of our way to provoke them, you can count on that. The last thing any of us miners are looking for is to stir up trouble... All we're looking for is, well, all that glitters.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now there's a philosophy that Paimon can get behind.

response.speaker: Yuehui
response.text: ...I gotta be honest, I didn't really understand the situation you were describing, but having your assurance that everything's okay is the main thing. It means we can get back to work straight away.

response.speaker: Yuehui
response.text: I'm very grateful to you both! You came a long way for this. Please take these as compensation.

choices.text: You have nothing to worry about.
Hilichurl utopia. Hili-topia, if you will.
